# Station classics The old favourites from every galley in the sector still cook here, just by hand. Put the ingredients together on a prep board, and you'll get an unbaked dish ready for a hearth's oven or a pan. A few, like salads and many desserts, are ready the moment they come off the board.
They'll fill you up as well as ever, but only home-cooked dishes do anything more for you. [textlink="Cooking" link="WGCooking"] explains which.
